cases.candidate_script:
set -u
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-denial-proof-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/anchor-peer.err" & peer=$!
trap 'kill "$peer" 2>/dev/null; wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 denial) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340 BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_0X20=0
for item in 'ok.test AAAA' 'nx.ok.test A'; do
  read -r name typ <<< "$item"
  if dns query "$name" "$typ" -s 127.0.0.2 -t 3000 --validate > "$HOME/$name.out" 2> "$HOME/$name.err" && [ ! -s "$HOME/$name.out" ]; then echo "$name=validated-negative"; else echo "$name=unexpected"; exit 1; fi
done
for item in 'badnegative.test AAAA' 'fake.wildcard.test A'; do
  read -r name typ <<< "$item"
  if dns query "$name" "$typ" -s 127.0.0.2 -t 3000 --validate > "$HOME/$name.out" 2> "$HOME/$name.err"; then echo "$name=wrongly-accepted"; exit 1; else echo "$name=rejected"; fi
done
cases.purpose: Validate signed NODATA and NXDOMAIN while rejecting exact-owner NXDOMAIN and wildcard-type NODATA forgeries.
cases.oracle: Deterministic independently signed ECDSA zones and BIND delv controls classify both legitimate responses secure and both forged responses bogus before candidate checks.
cases.comparison: Require reference control, both valid negative responses, and both forged denials to be rejected.
